    ❓ WHAT DO THESE WORDS MEAN? tap to open
    Hit rate
    How often the pick was right. Voids (player didn't play) and pushes (landed exactly on the line) don't count either way.
    Needed to profit (break-even)
    The hit rate the price requires. At −110 you need 52.4%; PrizePicks 6-pick flex about 54.2%. Hitting 55% at a price that needs 57% still loses money.
    Units (U)
    Bet size. 1U is your normal bet. Flat 1U = what you'd have made betting 1 unit on everything. At our units = betting the recommended size shown next to each pick.
    Recommended units
    0.25U low (0+ pts over break-even)0.5U medium (2+ pts over break-even)0.75U lean (4+ pts over break-even)1U confident (6+ pts over break-even)1.5U high (9+ pts over break-even)2U extreme (13+ pts over break-even) NO BET chance doesn't beat the price
    Value / edge
    Our chance minus the break-even, in percentage points. 60% on a pick that needs 52.4% = 7.6 points of value.
    Closing line value (CLV)
    Did the line move our way after we froze the pick? Beating the closing line most of the time is the earliest sign of a real edge.
    Best 5 / Best Value
    Best 5 = highest chance on each list. Best Value = picks whose kind has really hit furthest above the price (ranked this way since Nov 7; before that by our chance minus the price). Both lock at tip.
    Lean / edge
    Every stat is a "lean" until its graded record beats the line; then it's labelled "edge".

    When to bet

    WHAT THIS TELLS YOU Every pick keeps following the lines and injury news until its own game tips, then locks. The site saves a copy of each pick at the opening line, 10 AM, 1 PM and 5 PM Central, and grades every copy. If the 10 AM row keeps winning more than "locked at tip", betting earlier is better, and the other way round. Beat the close = the line moved our way after that moment.

Patterns that showed up once and then reversed are listed as flipped, so you can see what was just noise.

    WHAT THIS TELLS YOU When a player is ruled out late, the site flags teammates who have done more (or less) in past games without him, at the line they had at the news, and grades every one. One play per player-stat per game, using every absence added together: if a second teammate is ruled out and moves the same player again, the two effects combine (net) and the play follows the net; if they offset to almost nothing there is nothing left to call. The news also moves the projection itself (half of the with/without difference), so picks, lists and parlays use it too. News plays carry no stake until they earn one.

Cautious = the low end of the likely hit rate (95%); a line is TRUSTED only when even that beats what it needs. So far the prices have been sharper than our own disagreements with them: picks where the site disagrees most with the market have done worst.

    Corrections switch on per stat once 50 graded picks exist: projection bias by tier, and a pull toward 50% if stated chances run hot. 33 of 33 active. On the 1st of each month the settings are re-fit and kept only if they beat the old ones on games they never saw.

    Weekly self-tuning

    Every week the site re-tests its main settings on games already played and keeps a change only if it lowers the projection miss on both earlier games and the last 7 days, without hurting a mid-season stretch of last season. Small steps, one setting at a time.

    Last run 2026-11-02: tried 20 nearby settings; none beat the current ones on both checks, so nothing changed. Tested on 2707 + 672 player-games.
